resources.string: We need step data to calculate your activity score.
To provide insights on your daily movement and biological age, Zyndio needs access to your step count.
We need heart rate data to monitor your stress and recovery.
Zyndio uses your heart rate to analyze your cardiovascular health and recovery.
We need sleep data to optimize your circadian rhythm.
Sleep quality is crucial for longevity. Allow access to analyze your rest patterns.
We need oxygen data for deep health insights.
This helps us track your respiratory efficiency and overall vitality.
We need workout data to track your fitness progress.
Zyndio analyzes your workouts to provide personalized fitness recommendations.
We need calorie data for nutritional guidance.
Total energy expenditure helps us tailor your diet plan.
